scope: Rule-agnostic scene questions for the 39 atoms that appear in a typed subject gate. The prompt never names a rule, a provision or a violation, so nothing leaks the retrieval target.

decoding.note: greedy decoding through the repository's local vLLM backend defaults; no constrained decoding is available on the local path

unknown_semantics: unclear, a missing id, an unparseable reply or a rejected observation all resolve to unknown. Unknown never excludes a provision.
instruction_template:
You are cataloguing what is visible in one photograph of a work site. For each numbered statement, answer strictly with one word:
  yes     — you can see that this is the case in this photograph.
  no      — you can see that this is NOT the case in this photograph.
  unclear — the framing, distance, lighting or occlusion does not let you decide.

Answer 'no' only when the photograph actually shows the absence. If you would have to guess, or the thing could easily be outside the frame, answer 'unclear'. Do not infer from what is typical on a work site; report only this photograph.

Statements:
{statements}

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else, mapping every statement id to "yes", "no" or "unclear". Include all {n} ids exactly once.

questions.basket_or_lifting_operation_present: A lifting operation is under way (crane, hoist or winch lifting a load), or a suspended work basket or platform is in use.
questions.climbing_behavior_present: A person is climbing on something that is not a staircase or a ladder — scaffolding, formwork, a structure, a wall or stacked material.
questions.construction_site_context: The scene is a construction site or a construction work area.
questions.dense_scaffold_present: Scaffolding is erected in the scene.
questions.dormitory_present: Worker living quarters are visible — a dormitory, sleeping room or bunk accommodation.
questions.dusty_material_present: Bulk dust-generating material is visible — sand, soil, gravel, cement, or a spoil heap.
questions.electrical_work_present: Electrical work is being carried out, or a person is handling electrical wiring, a distribution box or powered equipment.
questions.elevator_shaft_present: An elevator or lift shaft is visible.
questions.fire_access_or_exit_present: A fire access route, emergency exit or designated escape passage is visible.
questions.fire_box_or_fire_point_present: Fire-fighting equipment is visible — an extinguisher, fire point, fire cabinet or hose reel.
questions.guardrail_present: A guardrail, handrail, railing or protective barrier is visible.
questions.high_risk_operation_present: A high-risk operation is under way — lifting, demolition, deep excavation, confined-space work, scaffold erection or dismantling, or work at height.
questions.hoist_platform_present: A material hoist, construction lift, or its landing platform is visible.
questions.horizontal_opening_present: An opening in a floor, slab or deck is visible — a hole in a horizontal surface that a person could fall into.
questions.hot_work_present: Hot work is under way — welding, flame cutting, grinding that throws sparks, or an open flame.
questions.lifting_gear_present: Lifting gear is visible — slings, chains, wire rope, hooks or shackles.
questions.low_sill_opening_present: A window or wall opening with a low sill is visible — low enough that a person could fall through or over it.
questions.machine_operating: A construction machine is operating or moving — an excavator, loader, crane, roller, piling rig or a truck in motion.
questions.main_road_or_processing_area_present: A main site road, haul route, or a material processing or fabrication area is visible.
questions.main_site_vehicle_road_present: A main vehicle road inside the site is visible.
questions.manhole_or_trench_present: A manhole, inspection chamber, or a narrow trench is visible.
questions.materials_present: Construction materials are stacked or stored in the scene.
questions.noise_sensitive_buildings_nearby: Occupied residential or other noise-sensitive buildings are visible next to the site.
questions.passage_or_work_area_present: A pedestrian passage, walkway, or a defined work area where people move on foot is visible.
questions.person_present: At least one person is visible.
questions.pit_or_trench_edge_present: The edge of an excavation is visible — a pit, ditch or trench someone could fall into.
questions.roof_balcony_platform_edge_present: The edge of a roof, balcony, slab or raised platform is visible.
questions.scaffold_structure_gap_present: There is a visible gap between the scaffolding and the building structure it serves.
questions.shaft_opening_present: A service shaft, duct or pipe shaft opening is visible.
questions.site_boundary_present: The site boundary is visible — hoarding, perimeter fence or enclosure wall.
questions.site_exit_present: A site exit where vehicles leave the site is visible.
questions.site_gate_present: A site gate or main entrance is visible.
questions.special_operation_present: A licensed special operation is under way — crane operation, welding, electrician work, scaffolder work or hoist operation.
questions.stair_edge_present: A staircase, stair flight or stair landing is visible.
questions.temporary_cable_present: Temporary electrical cable or extension leads are visible.
questions.temporary_facilities_present: Temporary site facilities are visible — a site office, container unit, canteen, toilet or shed.
questions.vertical_opening_present: An opening in a wall or facade is visible — a vertical opening a person could fall through.
questions.waste_or_spoil_present: Construction waste, debris or excavated spoil is visible.
